patch_description: Replace the current chain-style ansatz with the higher-performing block-diagonal structure from the best prior seed (RY_a/RY_b -> CNOT ring -> RZ_a/RZ_b -> reverse CNOT ring -> CRZ(ent) pairs -> final RY_c), which previously scored 0.42 vs the current 0.40. Additionally apply the suggested refinement: split the shared "ent" CRZ parameter into two group-specific entanglers — "ent_e" for even-indexed pairs [0,1] and [4,5], and "ent_o" for odd-indexed pairs [2,3] and [6,7]. This gives finer-grained control over even vs. odd neighbor correlations at the cost of only one extra parameter (7 distinct total), which prior evidence suggests tightens the decision boundary and improves worst-group margin/validation accuracy while keeping parameter count low.
